positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · Hybrid
Santa Clara County, California, United States

positions.title: Lead Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and delivered private cloud project using Angular 
• Restructured the web user interface to support access control to pages and features based on user roles, permissions and license management
• Covered 90% unit test cases using karma and jasmine
• Improved user usability on VMware vSphere plug-in user interface
• Performed redesign on our installation project user interface to meet new criteria provided by DevOps team
• Worked on the installation project backend to support new workflow using Node.js
• Updated installation backend from running scripts to work with provided ansible playbooks

positions.title: Software Engineer (Web)
positions.description:
• Involved in decoupling, architecting, and developing main product web user interface using Angular
• Involved in major redesign to web user interface following designer team mockups
• Hands-on migration of Angular 4 to Angular 7
• Documented features and technical specifications, including use cases and user stories
• Worked on Cross-Browser compatibility and fixed the bugs for several browsers
• Created reusable components, directives, services, and modules improving the overall web user interface performance
• Improved user accessibility and design of marketing website

positions.title: Lead Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Held team lead position on Agile Scrum project, responsible for coordinating and facilitating development effort of team members.
• Managed team of 3 developers and 1 QA engineer
• Involved in decoupling, architecting and developing Klinche Front End web portal using Angular
• Participated in design discussions and pre-sprint planning
• Performed major redesign to web portal following directions from product and UX team
• Maintained software workflow management using Gitlab, as well git for code versioning tool.
• Collaborated with an offshore backend team on API design and integration
• Perform troubleshooting of any issues that may arise in any of our environments
• Created technical documentation to support maintenance
• Conducted code peer reviews with other member in the team
• Mentored and coached junior developers and QA

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with stakeholders to gather functional and technical requirements
• Followed coding guidelines and MVC design patterns
• Developed web portal using MySQL and PHP.
• Documented features and technical specifications.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
• Used Swift to develop and maintain Klinche iOS App
• Worked closely with product management and UX team to deliver updates.
• Managed deployment activities such as sending builds to test devices

projects.title: ServiceU
projects.description:
- Architected and built software-as-service project on PHP and MySQL
- Wrote server-side and client-side code to search within the database,
retrieve and show the data to the user according to specifications for the
search feature.
- Incorporated different frameworks for video calling and schedule features.
